standard_policy: Reproduce existing entered standard assignments unchanged; edition differences are context, not a readiness blocker or conformity verdict.

failure_policy.application_failure: record FAIL with evidence; never repair during the test
failure_policy.safety_or_session_failure: BLOCKED; no action/model call after failed gate
failure_policy.downstream_cases: Continue independently guarded work on existing source-matched probes after an ordinary task failure. Missing probes remain explicit blocked prerequisites; never preseed measured data or invent success. Critical safety/session/Oracle/harness faults stop all further work.

stress_definition: Bounded realistic workflow friction, validation, navigation, persistence, reporting and role behaviour; no throughput/DoS or unbounded destructive load.

resource_policy.token_policy: Record input/output/total when supplied; missing usage is unknown, not zero. Calls count executor and reviewer requests including failed requests.
resource_policy.time_policy: Elapsed controller wall time including model waits; observation marks are not performance acceptance criteria.

scope_boundary.future_release_actor: Separate agent/task; no release action in this series
scope_boundary.reviewer: Independent evidence review, not the acting laboratory or WPK account

execution_acceptance: Adapters are locally tested; first measured execution may uncover UI gaps. Readiness is separate from a completed benchmark.
